critical_failure: Fabricated material fact, unsupported cited claim, materially wrong calculation or undisclosed missing essential input

checks: Reconcile margin movement and forecast impact
Do not invent consensus or a beat/miss when absent
Separate operational facts from thesis inference
Separate statistical success from clinical relevance
Do not treat an assumed effect size as observed trial data
Prioritize questions tied to investment assumptions
Identify what would falsify the thesis
Retain downside, compliance and missing-data caveats
